answer: A terrace anchors each haven, one clone, to a shared uninterrupted epoch streak and weights each haven’s influence by the streak squared. Each admission extends that streak and burns one whole quill per point of the post-admission square; the terrace re-prices a simultaneous batch after every inclusion, so N clones cost 1²+…+N² quill and no quill covers two admissions. A forged epoch record breaks it.
